title: Kinetic typography with a running cat — cut-paper title reel

source.author: @higgsfield_ai
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the animation half of the El Gato Prime post (the original is a square split-screen with an After Effects screen recording underneath; only the animation is remade, at 16:9). The title words, sticker and closing line are ours; the Higgsfield corner badge is dropped.

scenes: cat eye opens inside hand-drawn rings, ticks and sparkles, pupil dilates and the camera dives in
road run: outlined title marquee, cat with ghost trails, black title pops and flies off
hero word 1 zooms out onto a boiling starburst, claw slashes, lime shape takes over
word 2 letters drop in with extrusion, the O holds an eye that becomes a cream wipe
cream dot grid: the cat gets a crown and smears off, word 3 pops in, purple wipe
fast cuts: word 1, word 2, eye, outlined word 3, flying cat
tilted rows of the full title scroll both ways, cats run through, dark band wipe
final: moon, rings, spaced top line, hero word slams in, crown, sparkles, tagline
notes: The O-eye in scene 4 appears when word 2 ends in O. Leave stk1 empty to hide the corner sticker. Everything is drawn in code: no image assets.
